description: ✨ Stunning air-conditioned triplex in the heart of Le Marais!Renovated and thoughtfully decorated by its owner, this triplex combines elegance, generous space, and high-quality materials. Each area offers a warm and unique atmosphere.Spacious, bright, and peaceful, it’s located in one of Paris’s most vibrant and charming neighborhoods — perfect for an unforgettable stay.🚇 Metro nearbyA rare find for a comfortable Parisian experience 💫The space✨ Discover this exceptional triplex in the heart of Le MaraisFully redesigned by an architect, this rare gem is tucked away in a quiet, tree-lined courtyard just steps from Place des Vosges, offering a truly unique Parisian experience 💫From the moment you enter, you’ll be charmed by its generous volumes, authentic Parisian stone, and warm, elegant atmosphere. The spacious living area is perfect for relaxing after a day exploring the city 🛋️🍽️ Fully equipped high-end kitchen (Smeg, marble)📶 High-speed Wi-Fi❄️ Air conditioning🧺 Laundry area🛏️ 3 private suites, true havens of peace:• Suite 1: Queen-size bed + bathroom with walk-in shower & double sink• Suite 2: Queen-size bed + elegant en-suite bathroom• Lower level: suite + bathtub + private cinema room 🎬Every detail has been carefully designed to combine comfort, style, and sophistication. Perfect for an unforgettable stay in Paris ✨⚠️ Important info:• No parties / respect for neighbors• Self check-in• Cleaning before & after stay• No hotel servicesA rare place to experience Paris differently 💎Guest accessThe apartment will be entirely at your disposal during your stay.To make your arrival easier, a self check-in system is available via a secure lockbox 🔐.
